title: A permission removed while a page is open makes the save refused
refs: SV-11705 (Story 16 S16-R5 S16 Error Handling (no PRD id; numbered here))
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a second Admin session open in another browser, signed in as an Admin who can change roles.
  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type 60 in Default's first range.
  5. In the second browser, remove 'See Financial Data' from the test user's role.
  6. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • Default's first range reads 60.

Step 5:

  • The role is saved without 'See Financial Data'.

Step 6:

  • The save is refused and "Access restricted" shows.
  • Reopened as an Admin, matrix A still shows Default on 50% markup: nothing was saved.
